seo.title: Best Cocktail Bars in Casablanca (2026) | tabiji.ai
seo.metaDescription: Discover Casablanca's vibrant cocktail scene with our top 12 picks. From chic rooftop bars to historic speakeasies, find the perfect spot for your next drink in Morocco's dynamic metropolis.

hero.subtitle: Casablanca's nightlife offers a sophisticated array of cocktail bars, blending Moroccan hospitality with international flair. From breathtaking ocean views to opulent hotel lounges, the city caters to every taste.

picks.name: Le Cabestan Ocean View
picks.whyItMadeTheList: An iconic Casablanca establishment, Le Cabestan offers breathtaking panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean, making it perfect for sundowners. Beyond the vista, their mixologists craft sophisticated cocktails, complemented by a refined Mediterranean-inspired menu and a chic, vibrant atmosphere.
picks.whatToOrder: Their signature 'Cabestan Royale' (a champagne-based cocktail) or a classic Negroni perfectly executed.
picks.insiderTip: Reserve a table on the terrace well in advance, especially around sunset, to secure the best ocean view spots.
picks.redditQuote: "Le Cabestan is *the* place in Casa for a fancy drink. The ocean views are just unreal, totally worth splurging a bit."

picks.name: Sky 28 (Kenzi Tower Hotel)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Perched on the 28th floor of one of Casablanca's tallest buildings, Sky 28 delivers unparalleled 360-degree city views. It's an ideal spot for enjoying expertly crafted cocktails and light bites in a sophisticated setting, often accompanied by live jazz or DJ sets.
picks.whatToOrder: Try their 'Casablanca Sunset' for a local twist, or any of their expertly prepared gin and tonics.
picks.insiderTip: Dress smart-casual; there's often a dress code. Go after dark to see the city lights sparkle.
picks.redditQuote: "Sky 28 definitely has the best views in Casablanca. Cocktails are pricey but excellent, and the atmosphere is super chic."

picks.name: Buddha-Bar Casablanca
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Part of the globally renowned Buddha-Bar empire, this Casablanca outpost brings its signature blend of exotic decor, ambient music, and pan-Asian flavors to the city. It's a high-energy spot known for its inventive cocktail menu and glamorous crowd, perfect for a lively night out.
picks.whatToOrder: Any of their 'signature' cocktails from the extensive menu, often featuring unique Asian-inspired ingredients.
picks.insiderTip: It gets very busy on weekends; make a reservation if you plan to dine or want a good spot in the lounge.
picks.redditQuote: "Buddha-Bar Casa is exactly what you'd expect: loud, fancy, and the drinks are amazing. Great vibe for a big night out."

picks.name: Moods (Four Seasons Hotel Casablanca)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Nestled within the luxurious Four Seasons Hotel, Moods offers a refined and intimate setting for discerning cocktail enthusiasts. With impeccable service, a chic interior, and an outdoor terrace overlooking the ocean, it's perfect for a sophisticated evening or a quiet drink.
picks.whatToOrder: Their bespoke cocktails, where the mixologist creates a drink tailored to your preferences, or a classic Old Fashioned.
picks.insiderTip: Take advantage of the terrace for beautiful sunset views over the Atlantic in a serene environment.
picks.redditQuote: "Moods at the Four Seasons is my go-to for a quiet, high-end cocktail. Service is top-notch and the drinks are always perfect."

picks.name: Rick's Cafe
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Recreating the legendary bar from the movie 'Casablanca', Rick's Cafe is an iconic landmark offering a nostalgic and romantic ambiance. While primarily a restaurant, its bar area is perfect for enjoying classic cocktails and soaking in the unique, cinematic atmosphere.
picks.whatToOrder: A classic 'French 75' or a 'Sidecar' to truly lean into the old-world charm.
picks.insiderTip: Visit in the evening for live piano music, which significantly enhances the immersive experience.
picks.redditQuote: "You can't go to Casa and not visit Rick's. The cocktails are good, but it's really about the atmosphere and feeling like you're in the movie."

picks.name: B-Rooftop (Hyatt Regency Casablanca)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Located atop the Hyatt Regency, B-Rooftop provides a vibrant urban escape with impressive views of the city center. It's a contemporary space where guests can enjoy creative cocktails, a selection of tapas, and a lively atmosphere, often with DJ performances.
picks.whatToOrder: Their 'Marrakesh Express' for a refreshing, local-inspired drink.
picks.insiderTip: Ideal for pre-dinner drinks or a relaxed evening. Check their schedule for themed nights or special events.
picks.redditQuote: "Had some great drinks at B-Rooftop last time I was in Casa. Good views of the square and the cocktails were really well made."

picks.name: L'Eglise
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Housed in a beautifully converted church, L'Eglise offers a truly unique and atmospheric setting. This bar-restaurant combines stunning architecture with a cozy, inviting ambiance, serving a diverse menu of cocktails alongside Mediterranean cuisine. It's a favorite for its distinctive charm.
picks.whatToOrder: Their 'Sacred Sangria' or a perfectly balanced Mojito.
picks.insiderTip: Explore the various seating areas; each offers a different perspective of the impressive interior.
picks.redditQuote: "L'Eglise is so cool! A bar in an old church? Genius. Drinks are good and the vibe is unlike anywhere else in Casablanca."

picks.name: The Bar (Sofitel Casablanca Tour Blanche)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Located in the sleek Sofitel Tour Blanche, The Bar offers a stylish and modern environment perfect for unwinding. With plush seating, sophisticated lighting, and a well-curated drink menu, it's a popular choice for both hotel guests and locals seeking a premium cocktail experience.
picks.whatToOrder: Any of their 'signature' martinis or a bespoke cocktail created by the skilled bartenders.
picks.insiderTip: Great for a discreet business meeting or a quiet drink before heading out to dinner.
picks.redditQuote: "The Bar at Sofitel is consistently good. The service is excellent and the drinks are always on point, never too crowded."

picks.name: Le Kimgalan
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Le Kimgalan is a lively and popular spot, known for its friendly atmosphere and diverse menu of tapas and cocktails. It's a place where locals gather for after-work drinks, offering a more casual yet still energetic vibe compared to some of the high-end hotel bars.
picks.whatToOrder: Their classic Caipirinha or a refreshing 'Moroccan Mint Julep'.
picks.insiderTip: It can get quite boisterous, especially later in the evening, so it's not ideal for a quiet conversation.
picks.redditQuote: "Kimgalan is always a blast. Good prices for drinks and the tapas are legit. Feels more 'local' than the hotel bars."

picks.name: Le Doge - Relais & Châteaux
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Set within a stunning Art Deco mansion, Le Doge offers an exclusive and intimate bar experience. The elegant decor, reminiscent of the 1930s, creates a sophisticated backdrop for enjoying classic cocktails and premium spirits. It's ideal for those seeking discretion and refined luxury.
picks.whatToOrder: A classic 'Manhattan' or an 'Old Fashioned' to match the timeless elegance of the setting.
picks.insiderTip: This is a perfect spot for a romantic evening or a sophisticated pre-dinner drink in a very unique setting.
picks.redditQuote: "Le Doge's bar feels like stepping back in time. It's super elegant and quiet, great for a proper cocktail and good conversation."

picks.name: Basmane (Hotel Val d'Anfa)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Located at the Hotel Val d'Anfa, Basmane provides a taste of traditional Moroccan elegance with its rich decor and often features live entertainment, including traditional music. It's a restaurant with a comfortable bar area, ideal for enjoying cocktails in an authentic, yet refined, Moroccan atmosphere.
picks.whatToOrder: A 'Spice Route' cocktail with local Moroccan flavors, or a classic gin and tonic.
picks.insiderTip: Check their schedule for live music performances to enhance your experience. It's a great spot to immerse in Moroccan culture.
picks.redditQuote: "Basmane has such a cool Moroccan vibe, especially when they have music. Cocktails are solid and it’s a nice change from the modern bars."

picks.name: La Terrasse by M (Hotel Le Casablanca)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Perched on the rooftop of Hotel Le Casablanca, La Terrasse by M offers a stylish and relaxed setting with city views. It's a popular spot for both locals and travelers to unwind with creative cocktails, light bites, and enjoy the pleasant Casablanca evenings.
picks.whatToOrder: A refreshing Aperol Spritz or one of their fruity house specials.
picks.insiderTip: This spot is great for a casual evening out. The vibe is chill and the service is attentive without being intrusive.
picks.redditQuote: "La Terrasse by M is a nice, relaxed rooftop. Not as 'grand' as Sky 28, but the drinks are good and it's a great place to chill."

faq.question: What is the typical price range for a cocktail in Casablanca?
faq.answer: The price for a cocktail in Casablanca typically ranges from MAD 100 to MAD 220, which is approximately $10 to $22 USD. Upscale hotel bars and fine dining establishments tend to be on the higher end of this scale, while more casual bars might offer slightly lower prices.

faq.question: Is alcohol widely available in Casablanca?
faq.answer: Yes, alcohol is widely available in Casablanca, especially in hotels, licensed restaurants, and dedicated bars. While Morocco is a Muslim country, Casablanca is a cosmopolitan city, and there are numerous establishments catering to those who wish to enjoy alcoholic beverages. However, it's generally not consumed in public spaces outside of licensed venues.

faq.question: What's the dress code for cocktail bars in Casablanca?
faq.answer: For most upscale cocktail bars and hotel lounges in Casablanca, a smart-casual dress code is advisable. This typically means no shorts or flip-flops for men, and women might opt for dresses, skirts, or smart trousers. More casual bars like Le Kimgalan have a relaxed dress code, but generally, dressing neatly is always a good idea.

faq.question: Are there non-alcoholic cocktail options available?
faq.answer: Absolutely! Most cocktail bars in Casablanca offer a variety of delicious non-alcoholic options, often referred to as 'mocktails.' These can be just as creatively crafted as their alcoholic counterparts, featuring fresh fruits, herbs, and spices. Don't hesitate to ask your bartender for recommendations.

faq.question: What areas of Casablanca are best for finding cocktail bars?
faq.answer: The most popular areas for cocktail bars in Casablanca are the Corniche Ain Diab, known for its oceanfront venues and lively nightlife; the Maârif district, which hosts several upscale hotel bars and lounges; and the city center (Downtown) around Place des Nations Unies. The Racine and Anfa neighborhoods also offer some chic options.

faq.question: Is it safe to go out to bars in Casablanca at night?
faq.answer: Casablanca is generally safe for tourists, and going out to bars at night is common. As with any major city, it's wise to be aware of your surroundings, avoid walking alone in poorly lit areas, and use reputable taxi services or ride-sharing apps like Careem or InDriver for transportation. Most popular bars are in well-trafficked areas.

methodology: Our selection process for Casablanca's best cocktail bars involved extensive research into local favorites, expert reviews, and online traveler feedback. We prioritized venues offering high-quality drinks, unique atmospheres, excellent service, and a distinct Casablanca experience.
